Project.Name: AI for Technical Debt Risk Quantification
Project.Title: AI for Technical Debt Risk Quantification: A Multi-Source, Forecast-Aware Framework for Evidence-Based Prioritization
Project.Subject: Software Management Lab Project
Project.Author: Student Lead & Software Engineering Lab Team

Task.Name: AI for Technical Debt Risk Quantification
Phase 1: Project Initiation and Planning
Task.Notes: Formal project chartering, stakeholder identification, boundary definitions, and baseline schedule approval.

Task.Name: Define technical debt quantification problem & lab scope
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Formulate core problem: distinguishing genuine debt from normal code churn, modeling principal, interest, and adverse risks.

Task.Name: Establish project research & engineering objectives
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Set SMART objectives: multi-source data ingestion, 4-dimensional quantification, explainable dashboard prototype.

Task.Name: Identify project boundaries, stakeholders & lab constraints
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Define boundaries: academic prototype, open-source repositories, no production deployment claims.

Task.Name: Define project deliverables & evaluation criteria
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Enumerate 12 project deliverables (D1 to D12) and map to verification gates.

Task.Name: Formalize academic assumptions & reproducibility constraints
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Document assumptions regarding synthetic vs. real commit logs, public repo availability, deterministic seeding.

Task.Name: Setup development repository & collaboration environment
Task.Notes: Configure Git repo, Python virtual environment, linter configurations, and issue tracking board.

Task.Name: Prepare initial work breakdown structure & schedule baseline
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Draft MS Project 12-week schedule, assign resources, verify critical path.

Task.Name: Conduct formal project initiation review with Faculty Supervisor
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. Present Project Charter and WBS to Faculty Supervisor for formal authorization.

Task.Name: Milestone 1: Project Charter & Plan Approved [D1]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D1. GATEWAY 1: Project Charter, scope boundaries, and initial baseline locked.

Task.Name: Phase 2: Research and Requirement Analysis
Task.Notes: Literature synthesis, technical debt taxonomics, SATD NLP analysis, and formal SRS baselining.

Task.Name: Survey state-of-the-art in technical debt quantification & metrics
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Review SQALE, SonarQube debt ratio, Alves et al., and machine learning debt detection papers.

Task.Name: Study AI/ML approaches for code smell & architectural debt detection
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Evaluate Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, GNNs, and Transformer models for detecting God Classes, Feature Envy.

Task.Name: Analyze Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) patterns & NLP classifiers
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Investigate Maldonado et al. datasets, source code comment patterns (TODO, FIXME, HACK, WORKAROUND).

Task.Name: Review principal estimation models (refactoring effort heuristics)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Analyze historical refactoring pull requests and commit churn as effort ground truth.

Task.Name: Examine interest forecasting models & time-series degradation dynamics
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Examine compound interest analogs, maintenance friction, and bug emergence rates over future horizons H.

Task.Name: Investigate multi-source adverse-event risk assessment formulations
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Study vulnerability linkage (CVEs), incident post-mortems, and service availability impact models.

Task.Name: Elicit functional requirements (detection, forecasting, dashboard)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D2. FR1: Multi-source ingestion, FR2: Debt confidence classification, FR3: Principal/interest forecasting, FR4: Risk ranking.

Task.Name: Define non-functional requirements (uncertainty, latency, explainability)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D2. NFR1: Confidence calibration (Brier score < 0.15), NFR2: Explainability provenance, NFR3: Sub-second dashboard query.

Task.Name: Formulate formalized system use cases & operational workflows [D3]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D3. Develop actor use cases: Software Architect, Engineering Lead, Quality Auditor, Developer.

Task.Name: Compile & baseline Software Requirement Specification (SRS)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D2. Synthesize IEEE 830-compliant Software Requirements Specification and Research Analysis Report.

Task.Name: Milestone 2: Requirements & Research Baseline Finalized [D2, D3]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D2. GATEWAY 2: Requirements signed off by Faculty Supervisor. Research baseline established.

Task.Name: Phase 3: System Architecture and Design
Task.Notes: Multi-source ingestion architecture, four-dimensional prediction pipeline, and explainable interface design.

Task.Name: Design high-level multi-source modular framework architecture
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Specify modular service boundaries: Ingestion, Feature Pipeline, Inference Engine, Aggregator, API Layer.

Task.Name: Design multi-source data ingestion & abstraction adapters
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Design pluggable connectors for Git repos, SonarQube REST APIs, Jira/GitHub issues, CVE feeds.

Task.Name: Formulate standardized technical-debt taxonomy & entity schema
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Define debt categories: Code Debt, Architectural Debt, Test Debt, Documentation Debt, Vulnerability Debt.

Task.Name: Define artifact identifier mapping (commits, AST nodes, issues, CVEs)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Establish composite primary keys linking file path, line range, AST node UUID, commit hash, and ticket ID.

Task.Name: Design AI candidate debt detection pipeline & feature extraction
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Architect feature extraction pipelines: code metrics (CK), churn history, and NLP comment embeddings.

Task.Name: Design principal estimation regression & calibration subsystem
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Design regression module predicting refactoring effort in person-hours with Platt/Isotonic calibration.

Task.Name: Design forecast-aware interest projection engine (horizon H)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Design time-dependent interest growth model evaluated over horizon H in {30, 90, 180} days.

Task.Name: Design adverse-event probability & impact scoring component
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Formulate Poisson/Survival risk curves for defect breakout and security vulnerability propagation.

Task.Name: Design multi-objective risk aggregation & prioritization algorithm
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Design Pareto multi-objective ranking incorporating business value, dependency graph centrality, and capacity.

Task.Name: Design explainability, evidence provenance & human-override UI
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Design UI wireframes: SHAP/LIME feature attributions, provenance drill-down, and manual engineer overrides.

Task.Name: Conduct architecture design review & threat modeling
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. Perform architecture walkthrough and threat modeling session with Faculty Supervisor.

Task.Name: Milestone 3: System Architecture Document Approved [D4]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D4. GATEWAY 3: System Architecture Document approved. Foundation for data prep and model implementation.

Task.Name: Phase 4: Data Collection and Preprocessing
Task.Notes: Multi-source extraction: source repositories, static analysis logs, commit churn, issue tickets, and feature engineering.

Task.Name: Identify open-source target repositories & synthetic sample sources
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Select representative open-source repositories (Apache Commons, Spring projects) and calibrate synthetic benchmarks.

Task.Name: Extract source-code repositories, AST structures & CK metrics
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Parse ASTs, compute Chidamber & Kemerer (CK) metrics: WMC, DIT, NOC, CBO, RFC, LCOM.

Task.Name: Mine static-analysis violation reports (SonarQube, linters)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Collect rule violations, code smell alerts, duplicate blocks, and estimated SQALE remediation minutes.

Task.Name: Extract commit logs, developer turnover & code churn histories
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Extract line churn, author experience, commit frequencies, and commit message semantics via PyDriller.

Task.Name: Harvest issue-tracker tickets, bug reports & SATD comments
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Harvest Jira tickets, GitHub Issues, and in-source comments containing self-admitted debt markers.

Task.Name: Extract architectural dependency graphs & coupling matrices
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Construct component dependency directed graphs, compute in-degree, out-degree, and cycle metrics.

Task.Name: Curate historical defect, security CVE & production outage logs
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Align post-release defects, CVE advisory IDs, and service outage severity logs with source components.

Task.Name: Formulate ground-truth labeling schema & technical debt categories
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Establish standardized ground-truth labels with inter-rater agreement (Cohen's Kappa) on sample subsets.

Task.Name: Clean raw records, filter noise & resolve missing data attributes
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Impute missing metric values, filter non-code files, deduplicate records, and verify integrity.

Task.Name: Engineer code complexity, structural & churn feature vectors
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Normalize structural features, generate ratio features (churn-to-LOC, defect density), scale features.

Task.Name: Engineer NLP feature representations for SATD & issue descriptions
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Generate TF-IDF and dense sentence-transformer embeddings for issue summaries and comment texts.

Task.Name: Partition stratified train, validation & held-out test splits
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Apply chronological and repository-aware stratification (70% train, 15% validation, 15% test) to prevent leakage.

Task.Name: Validate dataset quality, label distribution & provenance schema
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. Execute dataset sanity verification: distribution balance, schema conformance, provenance traceability.

Task.Name: Milestone 4: Preprocessed Multi-Source Dataset Validated [D5]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D5. GATEWAY 4: Multi-source training and evaluation dataset locked and versioned.

Task.Name: Phase 5: AI-Based Technical-Debt Detection
Task.Notes: Candidate debt classifier training, probability calibration (Debt Confidence Cd), and baseline benchmarking.

Task.Name: Formalize candidate debt detection objectives & target classes
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Specify classification targets: Code Debt, Architectural Debt, Test Debt, No-Debt.

Task.Name: Implement heuristic rule-based & static-threshold baseline detector
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Implement standard SonarQube / PMD static rule threshold detector as non-AI performance benchmark.

Task.Name: Assemble multi-modal feature vectors (code metrics + SATD embeddings)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Concatenate tabular software metrics with dense NLP embeddings into unified model input tensors.

Task.Name: Train candidate debt detection classification models
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Train XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest classifiers with class-weighted loss functions.

Task.Name: Calibrate model output to provide valid Debt Confidence probabilities
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Apply Isotonic Regression and Platt Scaling to convert raw logits into well-calibrated posterior probabilities P(Debt).

Task.Name: Perform hyperparameter tuning & cross-validation on candidate models
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Execute 5-fold cross-validation with Bayesian optimization for depth, learning rate, and regularizers.

Task.Name: Evaluate precision, recall, F1-score & ROC-AUC against baseline
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Perform empirical evaluation on held-out test split: compute Precision, Recall, Macro F1, Brier Score, and ROC-AUC.

Task.Name: Conduct qualitative human-in-the-loop sample prediction audits
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Inspect 50 high-confidence and 50 borderline candidate predictions to assess plausibility.

Task.Name: Package detection inference pipeline with uncertainty estimates
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Package model into callable Python API producing prediction tuple (is_debt, confidence_Cd, uncertainty_sigma).

Task.Name: Document detection architecture, calibration curves & error profiles
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. Generate technical documentation including reliability diagrams, confusion matrices, and feature importance.

Task.Name: Milestone 5: Debt Detection Component Completed [D6]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D6. GATEWAY 5: AI Debt Detection engine validated and packaged.

Task.Name: Phase 6: Technical-Debt Quantification and Forecasting
Task.Notes: Estimating Debt Principal Pd, forecasting Debt Interest Id(H), adverse-event probability modeling, and uncertainty.

Task.Name: Define target formulations for Principal (Pd) and Interest (Id(H))
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Formalize mathematical targets: Pd as one-time refactoring hours; Id(H) as accumulated maintenance friction over horizon H.

Task.Name: Prepare remediation effort calibration records (person-hours proxy)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Calibrate effort proxies using historical refactoring pull request review times and ticket resolution hours.

Task.Name: Develop Debt Principal (Pd) estimation regression component
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Train gradient-boosted regressor predicting remediation effort in person-hours with prediction intervals.

Task.Name: Define forecasting horizons (H = 30, 90, 180 days) for Debt Interest
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Establish operational forecasting intervals: 30 days (sprint), 90 days (quarterly release), 180 days (half-year roadmap).

Task.Name: Construct historical maintenance friction & churn velocity features
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Extract time-series metrics: historical bug-fix overhead, developer touch frequency, and churn velocity on debt-laden files.

Task.Name: Develop forecast-aware Debt Interest (Id(H)) projection model
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Build dynamic interest projection model predicting cumulative extra person-hours incurred across horizons H.

Task.Name: Formulate adverse-event probability model (P_event) via survival/risk curves
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Fit hazard/survival curves predicting time-to-outage, vulnerability exploitation probability, and critical defect eruption.

Task.Name: Define adverse-event impact severity categories & weight matrices
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Define impact matrices: Severity 1 (Critical Outage), Severity 2 (Severe CVE), Severity 3 (Release Blocker), Severity 4 (Minor).

Task.Name: Model remediation effectiveness factor (epsilon in [0, 1])
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Model fractional debt reduction epsilon achievable through refactoring without introducing regression risks.

Task.Name: Implement epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty bounds for estimates
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Compute 90% confidence intervals for principal Pd and interest Id using conformal prediction / quantile regression.

Task.Name: Validate individual dimension outputs & generate sanity checks
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. Verify dimension separability: confirm principal, interest, and adverse risk do not artificially collapse into single opaque metric.

Task.Name: Milestone 6: Quantification & Forecasting Components Verified [D7]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D7. GATEWAY 6: Principal, Interest, and Adverse-Event Risk prediction models verified.

Task.Name: Phase 7: Risk Aggregation and Prioritization
Task.Notes: Multi-criteria risk aggregation, dependency graph topology, knapsack capacity optimization, and ROI ranking.

Task.Name: Formulate risk-quantification composite data structure
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Build composite record schema: {item_id, Cd, Pd, [Id_30, Id_90, Id_180], Radv, epsilon, business_value, centrality}.

Task.Name: Integrate Debt Confidence (Cd) with Principal (Pd) and Interest (Id)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Compute expected net interest savings: E[Interest_Savings] = Cd * epsilon * Id(H) - Pd.

Task.Name: Incorporate adverse-event exposure (R_adv = P_event * Severity)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Weight risk-adjusted remediation value by prevented outage/vulnerability exposure Radv.

Task.Name: Integrate business criticality & operational asset value multipliers
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Incorporate service tiering (Tier-1 payment gateway vs. Tier-3 internal utility) as business benefit coefficient.

Task.Name: Factor in component topological dependencies (PageRank/centrality)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Propagate risk scores through component call graphs using dependency centrality to reward fixing foundational bottlenecks.

Task.Name: Implement engineering capacity & budget knapsack constraints
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Formulate 0-1 Knapsack / integer linear programming optimizer constrained by available sprint refactoring hours.

Task.Name: Implement multi-criteria risk ranking & Pareto frontier optimization
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Generate Pareto-optimal candidate rankings balancing immediate risk mitigation against remediation effort.

Task.Name: Benchmark risk-adjusted ranking against naive principal-only sorting
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Demonstrate that naive principal-only sorting (e.g. SQALE debt minutes) misallocates effort compared to forecast-aware risk.

Task.Name: Generate explainable remediation recommendations with ROI justification
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Output structured action recommendations detailing why item is ranked high, expected payoff, and risks of deferral.

Task.Name: Review risk prioritization outputs with domain engineering criteria
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. Verify prioritization behavior with Faculty Supervisor across varying developer team capacity scenarios.

Task.Name: Milestone 7: Risk Prioritization Engine Completed [D8]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D8. GATEWAY 7: Multi-source risk aggregation and prioritization algorithm completed and validated.

Task.Name: Phase 8: Explainability and Dashboard Development
Task.Notes: Interactive dashboard implementation: 4-dimension visualizers, dependency graphs, provenance, and human override.

Task.Name: Design user interaction flows, wireframes & component layout
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Produce responsive interface wireframes: Overview, Debt Catalog, Forecasting Explorer, Dependency View, and Admin.

Task.Name: Build interactive dashboard shell & navigational framework
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Implement web frontend shell (React/Tailwind or Streamlit/Dash), sidebar navigation, theme, and API client.

Task.Name: Implement Debt Overview view (confidence distribution & debt types)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Render aggregate metrics: total debt items, confidence distribution histogram, debt category breakdown.

Task.Name: Implement Multi-Horizon Interest Forecast visualizer (H=30, 90, 180)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Interactive slider for horizon H in {30, 90, 180} days; render cumulative interest growth curve with confidence bands.

Task.Name: Implement Adverse-Event Exposure & vulnerability risk matrix
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. 2D Risk Heatmap: X-axis = Event Probability P(event), Y-axis = Severity, with drill-down to CVE and outage records.

Task.Name: Implement Component Dependency Graph & ripple-effect visualizer
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Interactive node-link graph showing software components, color-coded by debt risk, with ripple-effect impact simulation.

Task.Name: Implement Evidence Provenance & feature attribution inspector
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Display SHAP/LIME feature attributions: show exact source code snippet, commit author churn, SonarQube smell, and SATD comment.

Task.Name: Implement Prioritized Action List with Knapsack capacity filter
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Interactive table with sprint budget slider (e.g. 80 hours refactoring budget) selecting optimal knapsack subset.

Task.Name: Implement Human Review, manual probability override & audit logger
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Enable engineer to flag false positives, adjust confidence Cd, provide justification, and record in immutable audit log.

Task.Name: Integrate back-end prediction engine APIs with dashboard UI
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Connect frontend components to FastAPI backend endpoints with asynchronous request caching.

Task.Name: Conduct usability testing & UI responsiveness optimization
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. Conduct lab usability walkthrough, verify layout responsiveness, optimize chart rendering for large repositories.

Task.Name: Milestone 8: Dashboard Prototype Completed & Functional [D9]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D9. GATEWAY 8: Explainable Technical Debt Dashboard prototype fully operational and tested.

Task.Name: Phase 9: Testing and Validation
Task.Notes: Empirical testing: model calibration, error metrics (MAE/RMSE), sensitivity analysis, and academic validity threats.

Task.Name: Formulate end-to-end testing & empirical validation protocol
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Define test protocol: unit test suites, model verification protocols, calibration checks, and threat analysis framework.

Task.Name: Execute data ingestion & schema integrity unit/integration tests
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Run automated test suite verifying edge cases in AST parsing, missing commit authors, and malformed issue JSON.

Task.Name: Perform functional verification of detection & quantification APIs
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Verify API endpoint correctness, response formats, parameter bounds (e.g. Cd in [0, 1], Pd >= 0).

Task.Name: Perform end-to-end dashboard interface & override testing
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Test human-override workflow, audit trail recording, knapsack slider updates, and chart filtering.

Task.Name: Evaluate model calibration (Brier score, reliability diagrams)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Plot calibration curves, compute Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Brier Score for Debt Confidence Cd.

Task.Name: Quantify prediction error metrics (MAE, RMSE for principal/interest)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Calculate Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) on effort regression and interest projections.

Task.Name: Compare risk-prioritization against baseline heuristic policies
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Benchmark proposed multi-source framework against: 1) Random sorting, 2) Naive SonarQube SQALE, 3) Churn-only sorting.

Task.Name: Conduct parameter sensitivity analysis across varying interest rates
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Evaluate sensitivity of priority rankings to variations in interest growth rate and adverse-event severity weights.

Task.Name: Evaluate system scalability & inference latency under batch workloads
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Measure runtime latency for 100,000 LOC codebase: AST extraction time, inference throughput, memory footprint.

Task.Name: Document academic threats to validity (internal, external, construct)
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Detail threats to validity: construct validity (effort proxies), internal validity (heuristic labeling), external validity.

Task.Name: Consolidate empirical validation results & ablation study findings
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Conduct ablation study: measure performance drop when removing commit churn, SATD NLP, or dependency centrality.

Task.Name: Compile comprehensive Testing & Validation Technical Report [D10]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Compile formal Validation Report with experimental charts, benchmark tables, and reproducible metrics.

Task.Name: Perform regression sign-off & code cleanup
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. Resolve minor bugs, ensure test pass rate = 100%, freeze evaluation code branch.

Task.Name: Milestone 9: Testing and Validation Completed [D10]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D10. GATEWAY 9: Testing, empirical benchmarking, and threats to validity formally completed.

Task.Name: Phase 10: Governance, Documentation, and Final Delivery
Task.Notes: Model governance, data provenance, final research paper, slide deck, mock defense, and lab submission.

Task.Name: Define AI model governance, monitoring & retraining protocol
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Establish governance framework: data drift monitoring, concept drift detection, quarterly model retraining triggers.

Task.Name: Document data provenance schema & data-sheet for dataset
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Author 'Datasheets for Datasets' adhering to Gebru et al. standards: motivation, composition, collection process.

Task.Name: Document model cards, prediction horizons & uncertainty guarantees
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Author Model Cards (Mitchell et al.) for detection, principal regression, and interest forecasting models.

Task.Name: Establish human-in-the-loop review policies & ethical safeguards
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Define ethical safeguards: human review required before enforcing refactoring blocks, bias mitigation against author metrics.

Task.Name: Document framework limitations, scope boundaries & future work
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Detail explicit limitations: dependency on git commit hygiene, language-specific AST parsers, future LLM extensions.

Task.Name: Prepare comprehensive software architecture & developer guide
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Write developer handbook: installation, API documentation, environment variables, reproducible Docker container.

Task.Name: Compile final academic research report & lab paper [D11]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Synthesize complete academic report formatted to conference / journal publication standards with full citations.

Task.Name: Assemble reproducible code, documentation & container artifacts
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Package reproducible Dockerfile, requirements.txt, seed data scripts, and automated demo runner.

Task.Name: Prepare slide deck & interactive viva demonstration script [D12]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D12. Design viva presentation slides (20 slides), live dashboard walkthrough script, and Q&A defense cheat sheet.

Task.Name: Conduct mock defense & rehearsal with Faculty Supervisor
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D12. Perform dry-run presentation, address supervisor feedback, fine-tune timing (15 min presentation + 10 min Q&A).

Task.Notes: Deliverable: D11. Final commit push, release tag v1.0.0, archive repository on university portal, finalize binder.

Task.Name: Milestone 10: Final Project Submission & Viva Defense [D11, D12]
Task.Notes: Deliverable: D12. FINAL GATEWAY: Formal submission of deliverables D1-D12 and successful viva defense in Software Management Lab.

Resource.Name: Project Manager / Student Lead
Resource.Notes: Role: Project Manager & Software Architect. Student team lead: Overall schedule baseline, scope management, risk aggregation policy, academic defense.

Resource.Name: Software Developer
Resource.Notes: Role: Full-Stack & Systems Engineer. Data ingestion pipeline, AST & code metric extractors, REST APIs, dashboard backend integration.

Resource.Name: AI/ML Developer
Resource.Notes: Role: Machine Learning Engineer. Debt detection classifiers, confidence calibration, principal regression, interest forecasting, uncertainty estimation.

Resource.Name: Data Analyst
Resource.Notes: Role: Empirical Data & Repository Miner. Mining git commits, SonarQube quality logs, issue trackers, SATD comments, dependency matrices, data cleaning.

Resource.Name: UI/UX Designer

Resource.Name: Software Tester

Resource.Name: Research Lead

Resource.Name: Faculty Supervisor
Resource.Notes: Role: Academic Advisor & Lab Examiner. Academic review, milestone gates sign-off, architecture critique, viva examination.
